faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NHSRC Consultant posts?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the NHSRC Consultant posts is 02-09-2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the maximum age limit for the Consultant posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Consultant posts advertised by NHSRC is 55 years. Specific age relaxation rules may apply as per government guidelines.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the Consultant posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications vary by post, but generally include B.E./B.Tech./MCA/M.E./M.Tech. or a Master’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or Engineering from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for NHSRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, as per the provided data, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary range for the Consultant positions?
faq.answer: The salary for the Consultant positions ranges from Rs. 1,00,000/- to Rs. 2,25,000/- per month, depending on the specific post and qualifications.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for Consultant - Java Developer?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies available for the post of Consultant - Java Developer in this recruitment drive.

faq.answer: The selection process for the Consultant posts typically involves a Written Test followed by an Interview.
